name: Infinite Fusion 2 Port
author: nickohlmeier
description: Near-1:1 port of Pokemon Infinite Fusion 2's real maps into the Multiverse Hub. Loads PIF2's actual Marshal-serialized .rxdata map data directly (same RGSS1/RPG Maker XP engine fork as the host), remapping switch/variable/map/tileset ids into a reserved block so they can't collide with the host's own live ids. Reuses MultiverseHub's existing PC 'Change Game' menu, warp system, and map-isolation hooks rather than duplicating them. Pilot scope: one real map (Littleroot Town) as an isolated warp destination, not yet connected to its real neighboring maps.
